text:
One Year

        I return here to tell myself my life
another autumn afternoon
old with
        thirty-three turns around the sun.
I return to fold back into this chair

        feeling its innocence of wood
now that the year makes its thunder

        and shakes me hard, from the root.
On the terrace I begin another descent
to
        hell, to winter.
The leaves of the trees bleed in me.

translation.title: Acacias
translation.editorial_note: The catalog title is 'Acacias,' but the body repeats 'One Year'; the translation keeps that mismatch visible.
